What we fix

The hot water faults we are called out for

Most Parramatta repair calls come down to one of these. Tell us which sounds like your unit and we will quote on that fault, not a generic call-out.

  1. No hot water at all

    The system has stopped heating completely, often an element, thermostat or ignition fault.

  2. Lukewarm or runs cold fast

    Water that never gets hot, or runs out quickly, usually points to a failing element or thermostat.

  3. Leaking unit

    Water pooling under or around the tank. Where it leaks from tells us whether it is a fitting or the tank itself.

  4. Pilot light will not stay lit

    A gas unit that keeps going out often needs a thermocouple, gas valve or ignition repair.

  5. Error code on the display

    Continuous flow and heat pump units show fault codes. We read the code and diagnose from there.

  6. Noisy, rusty or smelly water

    Banging, discoloured or odd smelling hot water can mean sediment, a spent anode or a valve at fault.

Scope

What a standard repair covers, and what it doesn't

Being clear up front saves you a wasted call-out. Here is where a repair is the right move and where replacement is the honest answer.

  • Inspection and fault diagnosis of the system
  • Testing of elements, thermostats, valves and controls
  • Checks for leaks, pressure issues and electrical faults
  • Compliant replacement parts and a safety check before restart
  • A clear explanation of what was wrong and what we did
  • The tank is severely corroded or leaking internally
  • The system is well past its typical service life
  • Replacement parts are no longer available for the model
  • A safety or compliance issue makes repair impractical
  • In those cases we explain your options, without pressure

  3. 03

    Our licensed team completes the repair or installation, then checks the tempering valve and relief valve are working as they should.

  4. 04

/* ---------- bands ---------- */

/* ---------- split ---------- */
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.02fr) minmax(0,.98fr);gap:clamp(32px,4.6vw,78px);align-items:center}

/* ---------- system type cards ---------- */

/* ---------- steps ---------- */

@media (max-width:700px){
  .shws-parramatta .loc-urgent-in{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .shws-parramatta .loc-menu a{grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px}
  .shws-parramatta .loc-menu-a{display:none}
  .shws-parramatta .loc-why{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .shws-parramatta .loc-end-nav ul{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .shws-parramatta .loc-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:4px;width:100%;border-radius:var(--r)}
  .shws-parramatta .loc-tab{text-align:center;border-radius:var(--r-sm)}
  .shws-parramatta .loc-fgrid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .shws-parramatta .loc-bgrid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .shws-parramatta .loc-ribbon-in{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .shws-parramatta .loc-ribbon-in li{border-left:0;padding-left:0}
  .shws-parramatta .loc-track{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:0}
  .shws-parramatta .loc-track li{padding-top:0;padding-left:34px;padding-bottom:22px}
  .shws-parramatta .loc-track li::before{top:0;bottom:0;left:7px;right:auto;width:2px;height:auto}
  .shws-parramatta .loc-track li:first-child::before{top:14px;left:7px}
  .shws-parramatta .loc-track li:last-child::before{bottom:auto;height:14px;right:auto;left:7px}
  .shws-parramatta .loc-track li::after{top:8px;left:1px}
  .shws-parramatta .loc-n, .shws-parramatta .loc-track h3, .shws-parramatta .loc-track p{text-align:left}
  .shws-parramatta .loc-faq .faq-a{padding-right:0}
  .shws-parramatta .loc-hero-act .btn, .shws-parramatta .loc-urgent-act .btn, .shws-parramatta .loc-end-act .btn{width:100%}
}
